market_events.catalyst: A cloud-platform capex update raises the expected AI infrastructure spend baseline for the next four quarters.
market_events.ai_relevance: The signal supports accelerator, custom silicon, networking, power, and cooling demand, while increasing scrutiny on cloud free cash flow and utilization.

market_events.catalyst: Supplier checks indicate HBM capacity remains allocated, with customer qualification and substrate availability limiting near-term upside.
market_events.ai_relevance: HBM remains a gating item for accelerator shipment flexibility and a positive mix driver for qualified memory suppliers.

market_events.catalyst: Foundry and supplier disclosures point to accelerated CoWoS capacity additions and related packaging equipment demand.
market_events.ai_relevance: CoWoS relief can unlock accelerator shipments and supports inspection, deposition, etch, and packaging equipment demand.

market_events.catalyst: AI accelerator and custom silicon roadmap checks show faster cadence but higher dependency on memory, packaging, and software readiness.
market_events.ai_relevance: Roadmap acceleration supports the silicon demand thesis while raising roadmap delivery and customer qualification risk.

market_events.catalyst: A long-duration power purchase agreement is linked to planned AI datacenter capacity in a constrained grid region.
market_events.ai_relevance: Power procurement is becoming a control point for AI capacity deployment and supports power, grid, and cooling suppliers.

market_events.catalyst: Utility filings and capacity trackers show nuclear restart and uprate plans being evaluated against AI datacenter demand.
market_events.ai_relevance: Reliable baseload capacity can change datacenter siting economics and increase visibility for electrical and grid services demand.

market_events.catalyst: Regulators update thresholds and license requirements for advanced AI accelerators, related components, and technical support.
market_events.ai_relevance: Policy changes can alter addressable market access, product mix, customer timing, and compliance costs.

market_events.catalyst: Rates and liquidity indicators shift less negatively for long-duration growth and infrastructure equities.
market_events.ai_relevance: Lower macro pressure can support valuation multiples, but crowded AI infrastructure winners remain vulnerable to reversal if yields rise again.

market_events.catalyst: Selected AI infrastructure enablers rerate faster than near-term estimate revisions, especially power, cooling, and networking names.
market_events.ai_relevance: Rerating confirms investor attention on enabling infrastructure but increases the importance of entry discipline, targets, and invalidation checks.

AnalystBrief.title: AI Infrastructure Situational Awareness Brief
AnalystBrief.executive_summary: The mock event set represents the full advisory workstation loop: source signals become evidence-backed market events, events propagate through AI infrastructure segments, tickers receive thesis and valuation context, deterministic risk and exposure checks shape advisory labels, and manual journal plus mock PnL data remain local-only. The strongest themes are hyperscaler capex, HBM scarcity, CoWoS expansion, and power capacity. The main offsets are export controls, valuation rerating, and the need to prove AI monetization against higher cloud capex.
